claims: The 2026 Men's Final Four is being held at Lucas Oil Stadium in Indianapolis, Indiana.
2026 Men's Final Four semifinal games are on Saturday, April 4, 2026.
2026 Men's Final Four championship game is on Monday, April 6, 2026.
2026 Men's Final Four matchups feature UCONN vs. Illinois and Michigan vs. Arizona.
2027 Men's Final Four is in Detroit, MI at Ford Field.
2028 Men's Final Four is in Las Vegas, NV at Allegiant Stadium.
2029 Men's Final Four is in Indianapolis, IN at Lucas Oil Stadium.
2026 Women's Final Four is scheduled for Phoenix, AZ.
